lots.title: Supply and delivery of Soft wood timbers
lots.description: Bristol City Council (BSH/HRA) requires supply and delivery of softwood timbers for its in-house joinery shop under a 48-month Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS). Lot covers softwood timber stock used by the Council's joinery manufacturing operations. Call-off volumes will be scheduled during the DPS term.
requirements: Contract term: 48 months commencing 01/12/2022 with no option to extend (§1 Proposed Contract 1.1-1.2).
Pricing quoted in pounds sterling (GBP) exclusive of VAT; prices remain fixed for the duration per §3 Price Adjustment 1.1.

Pricing must include collection, design, delivery, labour, materials, transport, plant, fuel, training, monitoring, management reports, disposal and recycling, and third-party charges (§3 Pricing 1.2).
Bids must be submitted via the ProContract e-Tendering System; no hard-copy submissions accepted (§2 Submission of Bid 1.1-1.5).
Bids to remain open for acceptance for 180 days from closing date (§2 Bid Validity 1.1).
Bidders must comply with Public Contracts Regulations 2015 under the Open procedure (§1 Procurement Process 1.1).
Supplier commitment to Living Wage Foundation rate expected for staff employed on this contract (§2 Living Wage Foundation 1.3).
Compliance with Bristol Clean Air Zone requirements expected; any CAZ charges borne by the supplier (FOREWORD 1.4 on Climate Change).
Suppliers must record and report Scope 1, 2 and 3 Greenhouse Gas emissions per the GHG Protocol (FOREWORD on Climate Emergency).
Contract Management: winning supplier(s) must submit monitoring information to demonstrate commitments are being delivered (§3 Monitoring and Contract Management 1.1).

warnings.message: Lot 1 (Softwood timbers) is numbered first in the tender's own sequence (1.1.1) but appears later in the Docling-extracted markdown (§4 SECTION FOUR: CONTRACT region) than Lots 2 and 3, which both appear together at §1 Lots (1.1.2, 1.1.3). The three-lot structure is therefore reconstructed from numbered enumeration markers rather than contiguous list order.

No product technical standards (e.g., BS EN 14081 for graded softwood, BS EN 1995 timber design, FSC/PEFC chain-of-custody, BS EN 636/BS EN 314 for plywood, BS 1186 for joinery) are cited in this document. The markdown only cites procedural/legal standards (Public Contracts Regulations 2015, Equality Act 2010, Bribery Act 2010, Fraud Act 2006, Data Protection Act 2018, GHG Protocol, Social Value Act 2012) plus fleet safety schemes (CLOCS, FORS). Product-level standards are likely in a separate technical specification document that was not included in this extraction.

Document was tagged document_role = technical_specification but the content is structurally an Invitation to Tender (ITT / Instructions to Bidders) with procedural rather than product-specification content. Lot titles, evaluation gates, and call-off mechanics are recoverable; product technical attributes (species grades, dimensional specs, tolerances) are not present.

CPV codes (03419000-0 Timber, 44220000-8 Builders' joinery) are attributed to all three lots based on notice-level main_category metadata passed in process_context, not from explicit CPV references in this tender-spec markdown. Lot-specific CPV refinement is not possible from this document alone.
Only the total estimated contract value is stated (£1,400,000.00 ex-VAT across all lots and 48 months, §1 Proposed Contract 1.3). Per-lot values are not broken out in the document.

Docling-extracted markdown does not expose explicit page-level anchors; page_ref values were estimated from the document's own Table of Contents page numbers (e.g. FOREWORD=3, Lots=5, Evaluation=17, Pricing=18, Social Value=19). Section refs are authoritative.

evidence_anchors.section_ref: §1 SECTION ONE: BACKGROUND AND OVERVIEW / Proposed Contract
evidence_anchors.anchor_text: The contract length will be for 48 months, with no option to extend. The anticipated commencement date is 1 December 2022. The estimated total value of this contract (inclusive of options) is £1,400,000.00.
The council intents to split the contract into the following lots: 1.1.2. Lot 2 - Supply and delivery of Plywood and Door Blanks; 1.1.3. Lot 3 - Supply and delivery of Hardwood and Hemlock
1.1.1. Lot 1 - Supply and delivery of Soft wood timbers

The procurement process will be conducted in accordance with the requirements of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015. Specifically, the Council will be using the Open procedure. Find a Tender Service (FTS) Contract Notice reference number BRISTOLCC001-DN625127-70301139 dated 14/09/2022.

Bids will be assessed in accordance Appendix 1: Evaluation Criteria. Evaluation will consist of one stage. Stage 1: Selection Criteria ... Stage 2: Award Criteria ... The council will evaluate on the basis of Technical Assessment.
Call Off between £0 and £25k - Will be 100% Price. Call Off above £25k - Will be 60% - 80% Price and Quality 0% - 20% and Social Value 20%

Pricing will be evaluated against the cost to provide the goods/works/service in the specification. The pricing must include and allow for everything that might be required under the contract ... All rates and prices must be quoted in pounds sterling (GBP). VAT should not be included in the bid rates and prices.
Social Value will only apply for project over £25,000
